newsitem.title: USA: Three-Five sees improved Q4 revs over Q3.
newsitem.headline: Three-Five sees improved Q4 revs over Q3.

text.p: Three-Five Systems Inc said Tuesday its fourth quarter will likely show some revenue improvement over the third quarter.

"Although this has been a very disappointing year, we feel we have passed a critical point and can look forward with optimism ... the fourth quarter will likely show some revenue improvement over the third quarter," said President David Buchanan in a statement.
He also said that revenues in 1997 could return to 1995 levels, or better.

Earlier Three-Five reported a loss for the third quarter of $0.70 a share compared with a profit of $0.17 a share in the year-ago period. That loss included the effect of a $0.55 charge for excess inventory.
